recipe.name: mesh
recipe.policy: Observed draw counts/topology/API and adjacent state-change frequencies; generated valid resources and shaders, no sleeps or added busywork.
recipe.limits: GL structural surrogate; original resource payloads, shaders, and unobserved between-draw commands are not reconstructed. Live perturbation remains mandatory.

primitive_catalog.label: GL draw interposer dispatch
primitive_catalog.description: Synthetic enable+draw loop bare vs dylib-interposed; aggregate instrumentation reference only (not subtracted by bias_adjust_inclusive_cpu).

primitive_catalog.label: REFERENCE activation tax
primitive_catalog.description: Aggregate loaded-disabled → lean REFERENCE; not additive with decomposition primitives.

primitive_catalog.label: COUNTERS incremental tax
primitive_catalog.description: Aggregate reference → counters profile path; reconciliation target for decomposition sum.

primitive_catalog.label: scope_begin/end + scope snapshot
primitive_catalog.description: Counters-lite (scopes disabled) → full counters (scopes restored). Slope is an approximate ns/scope-call bundle (includes Q-tree snapshot work).

primitive_catalog.label: per-frame counter flush
primitive_catalog.description: Deferred flush → immediate flush on counters-lite path (positive flush cost).

primitive_catalog.label: GPU timestamp insertion
primitive_catalog.description: Sampled detail window, forensic records off: GPU timestamps 0 → 1. Operations are test_gpu_stamps (each glQueryCounter stamp); includes bundled query lifecycle overhead. Not part of counters_incremental reconciliation.

primitive_catalog.label: sparse timed GL draw clock
primitive_catalog.description: Sampled window with forensic/GPU off: draw timed-sample clocks 0 → 1 (EU4_TEST_DRAW_TIMED_SAMPLES). Operations from F.draw_timed_samples.

limitations: Training mesh recipe only; slopes are synthetic-harness estimates.
External harness thread CPU only; not profiler self-timers.
Does not change Tier-1 admission or WP11 terminal qualification.
bias_adjust_inclusive_cpu() uses decomposition primitives only; never sum aggregate controls with decomposition.
